releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram capacity errors show clear busy message + Resume/Retry buttons (same message, no copy-paste)
Feature: Auto-probe Cursor models after busy errors, pick quietest, announce switch, and resend once
Fix: Duplicate plan files from double create_plan — keep only the latest per turn
Fix: Capacity auto-retry no longer cancels its own turn when switching models
